title: Argentina Census Catalog
description: Argentina National Population and Housing Census data at the census-tract (radio censal) level, covering four census years: 1991, 2001, 2010, and 2022. Tabular microdata from INDEC is joined with standardized GeoParquet tract geometries reprojected to EPSG:4326, enabling spatial analysis of demographic and housing variables across provinces and departments.

## Processing Notes

Census data from INDEC (Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos).
Census tract geometries from Rodriguez & de Grande (CONICET), reprojected to EPSG:4326.
Processing code: https://github.com/nlebovits/ciut-redatam
